decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around the Human creature type. By utilizing cards like Aether Vial, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Champion of the Parish, the deck aims to quickly build a powerful board presence. In addition, the inclusion of disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Reflector Mage helps to control the opponent's options while pushing for damage. The mana base of the deck is carefully optimized with Unclaimed Territory, Cavern of Souls, and Silent Clearing to ensure consistent creature casting.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Explore and Search for Tomorrow to get enough lands in play to cast Scapeshift. The goal is to sacrifice lands with Scapeshift to search for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and other Mountain cards, dealing massive damage to the opponent. Wrenn and Six provide additional value by recurring lands from the graveyard, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help control the board. Wish allows for additional versatility in accessing sideboard cards when needed.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through a variety of powerful spells and abilities. It utilizes Counterspells to disrupt the opponent's plans while also utilizing removal spells like Solitude and Prismatic Ending. The deck also has access to card advantage through Teferi, Time Raveler and card selection with Bring to Light. The win conditions of the deck include powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines, as well as Valki, God of Lies and The One Ring to close out the game. It also has access to extra turns with Time Warp for additional advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game using a mix of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, along with versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The deck also utilizes the landfall ability of cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and the adventure mechanic of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and outvalue opponents in the long game. The inclusion of unique enchantments like Leyline Binding and powerful artifacts like The One Ring adds another layer of control and resource denial to the strategy.

The deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to put pressure on the opponent. It includes a combination of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to control the board while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. Feign Death and Undying Malice help to protect and recur key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fury provide additional damage and versatility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggressive strategy in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to use a combination of cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, along with cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, to fill up the graveyard with creatures and then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Grief and Waker of Waves to disrupt the opponent's game plan while the deck sets up its combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of powerful creatures and win the game quickly.

The key concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also applying pressure with fast and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck aims to maintain board control through removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, while also utilizing cards like Feign Death and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate advantage and outvalue the opponent. Ultimately, the goal is to close out the game quickly with a combination of damage and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board while countering opponent's spells with cards like Spell Pierce and Counterspell. The inclusion of cards like Expressive Iteration and Preordain help to maintain card advantage and ensure the deck can consistently apply pressure throughout the game. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Force of Negation to disrupt opponent's game plan and secure victories.

This deck focuses on aggressively casting Cascade spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can constantly put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety. The deck also includes flexible removal options like Dead / Gone and Dismember to deal with opposing threats. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands that enable cascading, this deck aims to win the game swiftly before the opponent can fully execute their strategy.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. It also includes powerful cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to generate value and maintain board presence. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its diverse color requirements, and cards like Bring to Light and Eternal Witness provide flexibility and card advantage. The inclusion of leyline bindings and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines helps to disrupt opponent's strategies and stabilize the board.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on efficiently playing threats while disrupting your opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. By leveraging powerful cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional threats and potential ways to close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive while still having the tools to interact with the opponent.
